name: UI Watchlists RC Gate

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.9'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          source /Users/macbook-dev/Documents/GitHub/tldw_server2/.venv/bin/activate && python -m pytest -q tldw_Server_API/tests/MediaIngestion_NEW/integration/test_ingest_jobs_batch_cancel.py tldw_Server_API/tests/MediaIngestion_NEW/integration/test_ingest_jobs_events_stream.py tldw_Server_API/tests/MediaIngestion_NEW/unit/test_ingest_jobs_batch_lookup.py

      - name: Run E2E tests
        env:
          TLDW_E2E_SERVER_URL: 127.0.0.1:8000
          TLDW_E2E_API_KEY: THIS-IS-A-SECURE-KEY-123-FAKE-KEY
        run: |
          bunx playwright test e2e/workflows/media-ingest.spec.ts --grep "should cancel quick ingest mid-process with confirmation" --reporter=line

      - name: Security scan
        run: |
          source /Users/macbook-dev/Documents/GitHub/tldw_server2/.venv/bin/activate && python -m bandit -r tldw_Server_API/app/api/v1/endpoints/media/ingest_jobs.py tldw_Server_API/app/core/Jobs/manager.py -f json -o /tmp/bandit_quick_ingest_phase2.json

  cancel-previous-runs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Cancel previous runs
        uses: styfle/cancel-workflow-action@0.12.1
        with:
          workflow_id: ${{ github.workflow }}
          ignore_sha: true
          access_token: ${{ github.token }}

  notify-slack:
    needs: build-and-test
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Notify Slack
        uses: act10ns/slack@44541246747a30eb3102d87f7a4cc5471b0ffb7d
        with:
          webhook-url: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
          status: ${{ job.status }}
          steps: ${{ toJson(needs.build-and-test.outcomes) }}
          matrix: ${{ toJson(needs.build-and-test.strategy.matrix) }}
          channel: '#ci-notifications'
          message: ${{ format('Workflow {0} {1}', github.workflow, job.status) }}
